name: Company Registry Lookup
description: Registry Lookup gives AI assistants real-time access to the world's largest free company database — 521M+ legal entities across 310 jurisdictions and 244 countries. Search companies by name, look up entities by registry number, browse jurisdictions, and retrieve full registry profiles including legal form, status, incorporation date, registered address, and identifiers (LEI, VAT, tax ID). Built on Veridion's global data, updated weekly. Free API with 5,000 calls/month.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Company Registry Lookup to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Company Registry Lookup to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://registry-lookup.com/mcp/sse. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Company Registry Lookup MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Company Registry Lookup provides these MCP tools: autocomplete_companies, get_company, get_company_by_registry, get_jurisdictions, get_stats, and search_companies.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Company Registry Lookup?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Company Registry Lookup in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Company Registry Lookup MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Company Registry Lookup requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Company Registry Lookup is developed by Registry Lookup. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
